reviews.text:
Dr. Nicoletta examined my cat and was very thorough, professional, and kind, which is not a given.
The other doctors were also very good.
I recommend this veterinary practice and will always take my pets there.

I'm a follower of Silvia's, and have been following her for years now... even though she's far away from me! She's serious, kind, very knowledgeable, a great diagnostician, and always available. She explains things clearly... you're not just a number!
The doctors at this clinic are very competent and treat animals with heart and patience.
I highly recommend this clinic where our little friends are cared for with love, dedication, and compassion by wonderful veterinarians.

My pet, that is, the dog, whose name is Benito, at first understands that we are entering the vet but immediately afterwards he is happy because he finds safety, professionalism and kindness so much so that he feels bitter
Excellent clinic for its professionalism, helpfulness, and kindness. We discovered it when we lived in the area, but we still come back here today, despite the greater distance.

After a mix-up with another vet, I was looking for a serious and qualified professional, which isn't easy to find when you've lost trust. I finally turned to Linneo. I have two 15-year-old cats, one with oral problems and the other with no idea why he kept losing weight. The doctor quickly solved both of their problems. Pippo needed oral surgery to extract some teeth and clean the others. The operation went very well, with seven teeth removed. The next day, he was already eating wet food in small pieces. Unfortunately, the other Flash's tests revealed that he has hyperthyroidism plus kidney failure. The doctor prescribed a treatment, and in two days the cat stopped losing weight. Now, little by little, he needs to regain weight. I highly recommend this clinic. In addition to being competent, they also have a method. My cats are also difficult to visit because they are aggressive with people they don't know. The doctor did everything possible to avoid traumatizing them with aggressive methods. I won't change anymore, and I'm happy to have found the right staff for my two "children."

We've known Dr. Silvia for seven years, and she's a caring, meticulous, and helpful professional, capable of providing thorough explanations and instilling peace of mind.
She's passionate about her work and is always kind to our son Kimbo, who had a teeth cleaning with several extractions yesterday!
Great team: excellent surgery and helpful post-op support.
Thank you ♥️
Always a positive experience, Dr. Gabbiadini is helpful and very professional. Recommended!

From the first contact, I had a great impression. They were helpful, punctual, courteous, precise, and so passionate about their work. I use the plural because I had the opportunity to meet some of the staff, and Dr. Silvia put my four-legged friend, who was a little nervous, at ease. :) First visit, excellent impression. I highly recommend.

We chose it for our first kitten because it was close to home, but I have to say I had a great experience. The doctors are friendly and explain everything, clearing up any doubts you might have. They're incredibly kind to animals and treat them really well!
I'm happy to have a 5-star clinic nearby! Recommended

Total negligence on the part of the doctor.
She recommended a teeth cleaning for significant bleeding, instead of suggesting or conducting appropriate tests and investigations.
The kitten, due to gross negligence, died prematurely.
Highly inadvisable if you are known for your unconditional love for your furry friends!

Helpful, kind, and very professional.
I recommend
I had a great experience, they were quick and very courteous.
Dr. Gabbiadini is a serious and competent person, I feel very comfortable with him.
I finally found a good vet. Davide is always available and you can tell he loves animals. Thank you for taking care of my dogs.
